description: This header file declares functions and structures related to inter-process communication (IPC) for the filesystem monitor daemon in the Git project. It provides interfaces to check support, retrieve paths, get daemon state, and send commands or queries to the daemon.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Retrieves the pathname to the IPC communication point (named pipe or Unix domain socket) for the daemon, specific to a repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines if the `git-fsmonitor--daemon` process is active and listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Sends a query to the daemon to get changed files since a provided token, utilizing simple-ipc.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon using simple-ipc without attempting to start a daemon if none is running.
